item.title: Wakayama Mikan: Japan's Mandarin Orange Capital — Guide
item.description: Wakayama is Japan’s leading producer of mikan (satsuma mandarin), and the fruit is woven into the prefecture’s identity: the warm, sunny hillsides above the Kii coast are terraced with orange groves that turn the slopes brilliant orange from late autumn, and the region’s Arida district is one of the most famous mikan names in the country. From October through winter, orchards around Arida, Yuasa and the coast open for all-you-can-pick sessions, and roadside stands sell fruit picked that morning — sweeter and juicier than anything found in a supermarket.
